annotations.title: Add an import to a list

description: Add the kept entries of an import to a list, privately: the list given at start_import, another list of theirs, or a new private list. Safe to retry; nothing is added twice. A Google Maps list can stay connected so new saves there show up later.

connect.description: Keep a Google Maps list connected (default true).

list.description: Destination, when start_import had none. Omit to make a new private list.

new_list_title.description: Title for a new list. Defaults to the source's title.

name: commit_import
